# External crates allowed in haecceity's public API.
# std, core and alloc are always allowed; every other entry requires a reason.
# Format: <crate_name> # <reason>
serde_core # Serialize/Deserialize derives via serde on json/manifest public types
serde_json # haecceity::json exposes serde_json::Value and From<serde_json::Error>
